title: Trump Clashes with Kyiv as Wi-Fi 7 Becomes a Radio
description: Donald Trump denounces Ukraine's refinery strikes following a collapsed ceasefire, while an open-source project turns a consumer Wi-Fi 7 router into a wideband software-defined radio.

stories.title: Trump calls Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a ‘disgrace’
stories.summary: Donald Trump criticized Ukraine's renewed drone strikes on Russian diesel refineries as a disgrace and called Volodymyr Zelenskyy difficult to deal with following the breakdown of an energy ceasefire.

stories.title: W1700K SDR turns a Wi-Fi 7 router into a 320 MSps software-defined radio receiver
stories.summary: Developer h0m3us3r released w1700k-sdr, an open-source project converting a Gemtek Wi-Fi 7 router into a wideband software-defined radio receiver streaming 320 MSps over 10 GbE.

stories.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
stories.summary: BBC Verify found that attacks on commercial vessels near the Strait of Hormuz hit a record high of 12 strikes in one week.

stories.title: Major investment to take Skeleton's valuation over €1 billion
stories.summary: Siemens invested at least €100 million in Estonian energy storage company Skeleton Technologies, lifting its valuation to €1 billion.

stories.title: A new report just busted another myth about heat pumps
stories.summary: A report covered by Grist found that electrical grids have ample capacity for heat pumps and that adoption will save ratepayers money.

stories.title: Monumentally expansive roguelike Caves of Qud is getting even bigger in December with an early access expansion that lets you play as messed up dogs and trees
stories.summary: Developer Freehold Games announced Diaspora, an early access expansion for the roguelike Caves of Qud allowing players to play as plants and animals.

stories.title: The secrets of Hohle Fels cave
stories.summary: An Aeon video explored ancient bird carvings from Hohle Fels cave, examining how symbolic art was essential to the evolutionary survival of early modern humans.

stories.title: China protests Estonian politicians attending a Taiwanese event in Tallinn
stories.summary: The Chinese Embassy in Estonia sent a diplomatic protest to the Riigikogu after Estonian lawmakers attended a celebration for Taiwan's National Day in Tallinn.

stories.title: "Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards", Sega say as they pull it from stores and restore the original
stories.summary: Sega and Creative Assembly pulled Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition from stores following quality complaints, reinstating the original version.

stories.title: How Do Fungi Keep the Planet Healthy?
stories.summary: Evolutionary biologist Toby Kiers detailed in Quanta Magazine how brainless fungal networks in soil negotiate nutrient trades with plants and store carbon underground.

stories.title: Abandoned Agricultural Mill in Śmiałowice, Poland
stories.summary: Atlas Obscura documented a preserved early 20th-century agricultural mill complex in Śmiałowice, Poland, built with grand estate architecture.
